data.title: Greece vs Germany – prediction, preview & betting tips – 04/10/2026
data.content:
They sit third in their Nations League group, and are in danger of failing to qualify for the knockouts if they do not get a positive result here.

Germany will be scarred by their defeat to Greece on home soil earlier this campaign too, and will be desperate to put things right.

## Greece vs. Germany form guide & betting tips

Greece vs. Germany — Last 5 Form Guide [...] Greece are unbeaten in the Nations League this campaign (W2, D1).
 Germany's win over Serbia ended a four-game winless run (D1, L3).
 Greece's win over Germany was their first in 10 H2Hs (D3, L7).

## Greece vs. Germany preview: Greeks to stay firm?

### Greece vs Germany — Tale of the Tape

Germany do not have any fresh concerns themselves, and Jurgen Klopp finally got his first win in charge against Serbia.

Once powerhouses of international football, the Germans have struggled in recent years, notably getting knocked out by Paraguay at the World Cup.
